full_run.cost_aggregation: For each arm and document use median whole-process user plus system CPU over five passes; report equal-document geometric ratios, process wall time and peak RSS, plus all setup and controller costs separately.
full_run.interpretation: Frozen diagnostic comparison. Any later promotion claim needs its own prospective gates and fresh data.
full_run.quality_aggregation: Average exact normalized Brier across windows within each document, then weight documents equally; retain fiction and nonfiction separately. Count mistakes and zero-target probabilities. Compare native against each of the four controls, with document-level paired differences.
full_run.unit: one arm and one document per fresh process

overlap.normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, collapse Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space, strip; encode UTF-8. Used for overlap checks only.
overlap.reference_scope: The complete frozen candidate train.txt and previously opened eval.txt, plus the extracted stored training memory.
overlap.sampling_diagnostic: For each document, sample 256 equally spaced normalized 32-byte spans; reject when at least half occur in another fresh document.
overlap.scope_limit: Literal overlap checks under these rules; semantic similarity and unrecorded training exposure remain unknown.
overlap.selected_context_rule: Every normalized 32-byte span from each selected context must be absent from each reference and every other fresh document.
overlap.shorter_shared_spans: Report selected-context 16-byte reference overlap as a diagnostic.
overlap.utf8_window_edges: The raw 64-byte contexts stay exact. For the normalized overlap view only, discard incomplete UTF-8 code points at the two context edges.
overlap.whole_document_rule: Reject raw or normalized duplicate documents and normalized containment.

selection_scope: A fixed twelve-document English domain-shift panel, six fiction and six nonfiction, one primary author per document. Inference is bounded to these documents and this frozen candidate.

source_rule.body: Exact bytes between the unique Project Gutenberg START and END marker lines; retain all editorial material inside those markers.

windows.order: Document order in this plan; increasing window index.
windows.replacement_policy: The twelve documents remain fixed. Shift only for the stated text-length rule. Any other failed intake rule blocks readiness.
windows.selection: Start at the v1 anchor; choose the smallest nonnegative shift at most 1024 bytes for which the 64-byte context has at least 32 normalized bytes and the 65-byte example fits. Preserve all other documents and windows; reject overlap or exhausted shifts.
